title: Home screen widgets
about: See your last synced Pulse metrics without opening the app. Widgets display health information on your home screen; add them only where you are comfortable showing it.
added: Confirm the widget on your home screen, then choose its metrics.
manual: Your launcher does not offer in-app pinning. Long-press your home screen, choose Widgets, then Pulse.
rebuild: This app build does not include widgets yet. Install a build with the widget module to use them.
refresh: Widgets update after Pulse syncs in the app or through its existing background sync. Android controls background timing; widgets are not live sensor readings.
choose: Choose up to %1$d metrics. Reconfigure later by long-pressing the widget on a supported launcher.
description: Your last synced Pulse health summary. Tap a metric to open its details.

state.open: Open Pulse and sync to see your data

chooseLarge: Choose up to %1$d metrics. Heart rate is always included in the large widget.
